read.thesis: Record $12.1B backlog (up 70% YoY) with Americas commercial HVAC bookings up 50% and Applied bookings up 130%; sell-in roughly equal to sell-through, so channel is not stuffed.

capex.quote: with expected CapEx of 2% to 3% of revenue in 2026

triggers.label: Backlog $12.1B, up 70% YoY
triggers.quote: Enterprise organic bookings were up 37%, driving record backlog of $12.1 billion, up 70% year-over-year.

triggers.label: Applied bookings up 130%
triggers.quote: Applied bookings were up 130%, marking our fourth consecutive quarter of growth above 100%.

triggers.label: FY EPS guide raised to $15.20-15.30
triggers.quote: adjusted EPS guidance to a range of $15.20 to $15.30

triggers.label: Sell-in ≈ sell-through YTD
triggers.quote: year-to-date sell-in is really approximately equal to sell-through

triggers.label: Applied capacity 4x in 3 years
triggers.quote: we've expanded our applied capacity 4x over the last 3 years.

guidance.quote: We are increasing our full year organic revenue growth outlook to approximately 9%
adjusted EPS guidance to a range of $15.20 to $15.30
For the third quarter, we expect organic revenue growth of approximately 10%
expected CapEx of 2% to 3% of revenue in 2026
we expect the stellar business to be $500 million in revenue this year, and nothing has changed there
a target deployment of $2.8 billion to $3.3 billion for the year

red_flags.label: Middle East revenue down ~30%, EMEA margin pressure
red_flags.quote: EMEA margins were impacted by the conflict in the Middle East.

red_flags.label: Stellar investments pulled forward; Q2 leverage below 25% target
red_flags.quote: We may have a quarter like the second quarter, we were below that, but that's okay

red_flags.label: Price below cost inflation in H2
red_flags.quote: price versus all inflation. It was a headwind in the second quarter as we thought.
